facing_note: Source front -Z maps through Blender C=(x,z,-y), then glTF export to Godot +Z. Rotate Y by PI for Godot -Z controller.
timing_note: Held discrete source poses; one tick presented at nominal30Hz. Source stream duration is signed16; -1 loops. Event/combat gating is in overlay code, not pose stream.
transform_note: Packed8byte perpart actor-space XYZ; position signed8, Euler angles12bits. Blender transform C*EulerXYZ*C^-1, C=(x,z,-y), translation=C*position*.01. glTF Y-up conversion is applied by exporter. Flat part bones deliberately preserve baked actor-space transforms.
